minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  AUGUST 20, 2024

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

City Clerk Pettit called the meeting to order at 5:02 pm.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Zerunyan
City Council Members Absent:  Schmitz, Stegura

In the absence of the Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem and by a majority consensus, the present
Council Members selected COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF to preside over the meeting.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

Led by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION

  Recommendation: That the City Council adopt Resolution No. 2586 canceling the
  November 5, 2024 election and appointing Velveth Schmitz, Debby Stegura and
  Frank Zerunyan each to four-year terms of office as Council Members.

City Clerk Pettit provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

City Clerk Pettit explained that those appointed tonight would still be considered “elected,”
in response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  ZERUNYAN, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2586 CANCELING THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024
  ELECTION AND APPOINTING VELVETH SCHMITZ, DEBBY STEGURA AND
  FRANK ZERUNYAN EACH TO FOUR-YEAR TERMS OF OFFICE AS
  COUNCIL MEMBERS.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  Schmitz, Stegura

5.  ADJOURNMENT

At 5:06 pm COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF adjourned the City Council meeting to the regular
City Council meeting on September 10, 2024 at 7:00 p.m.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Mayor
City Clerk

SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
AUGUST 20, 2024
